reasoning_path: 24 mm is 14.12 times the 1.7 mm annual normal
the report total anchor is 50 mm and Antofagasta supplies 0.48 of that anchor
largest gridded/statistical peak is 41.2 mm, below the report total anchor
loss counts support severity but do not diagnose rainfall anomaly

key_values.event_name: March 2015 Atacama Desert storm and flash floods

ranking_logic.scoring_stance: Rank intermediate variables by diagnostic leverage for the conclusion that the event is a local-climatology rainfall outlier, not a uniform extreme 50 mm precipitation-grid case.
ranking_logic.highest_weight: Local climatology ratio is thresholded against the arid-site annual normal and directly explains why modest absolute rain can be extraordinary in Atacama.
ranking_logic.secondary_weight: The largest grid peak below the report total rainfall anchor is the strongest negative check against the uniform 50 mm grid-case shortcut.
ranking_logic.lower_weight: Impact counts are important consequences but weaker meteorological discriminators; loss-count-only reasoning is rejected.

criteria.name: Returned JSON shape
criteria.description: Includes answer, target_family, computed_values, variable_scores, ranked_variables, key_variable, rejected_variable, and reasoning_path.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for parseable compact JSON with one missing or slightly renamed required field.

criteria.name: Top-ranked diagnostic variable
criteria.description: Ranks local_climatology_ratio first and explains why annual-normalized rainfall has the strongest leverage for the Atacama outlier conclusion.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points if the ratio is computed but not ranked first; award 1 point for a vague outlier argument without the ranking.

criteria.name: Local climatology calculation
criteria.description: Computes 24 / 1.7 = 14.12 times annual average for Antofagasta.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for using the correct inputs with minor rounding error, or 1 point for naming the ratio without calculation.

criteria.name: Daily and gridded rainfall calculations
criteria.description: Computes the 50 mm report rainfall anchor, 0.48 Antofagasta-to-report-total share, and 41.2 mm largest gridded/statistical event maximum.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit in proportion to the number of correct rainfall intermediates and formulas.

criteria.name: Ranks against the 50 mm grid-case shortcut
criteria.description: Uses the below-report-total largest grid peak to reject a uniform extreme 50 mm grid case while keeping it below the climatology ratio.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for recognizing the grid maximum is below the report total anchor without a clear ranking.

criteria.name: Impact evidence used as support only
criteria.description: Computes 146 killed-plus-missing people, 8000 impacted homes, and 0.25 swept-away share without treating loss counts as the meteorological key variable.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for correct impact counts but weak discussion of their diagnostic limits.

criteria.name: Evidence discipline and units
criteria.description: Uses only local rainfall, gridded/statistical summary, climatology, and original report-count evidence, with clear units and no response-priority advice.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for minor unit or wording issues that do not change the answer.
